marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 20 knots veering to southwest 15 late this
afternoon then increasing to west 25 near midnight. Wind diminishing to west 15
to 20 Monday evening. Scattered flurries changing to snow this afternoon then to
scattered flurries near midnight. Snow Monday morning changing to scattered
flurries near noon Monday. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>
